test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

My__ complaint__ is that the gardener dozes off during work.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Praise**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**complaint**" means expressing dissatisfaction or criticism. (असंतोष या आलोचना व्यक्त करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The customer filed a complaint with the company after receiving a damaged product in the mail.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of this would be a positive sentiment like "praise".
 
• Marked option **Praise **means expressing approval, admiration, or compliments for someone's achievements, qualities, or actions. (किसी की उपलब्धियों, गुणों या कार्यों के लिए अनुमोदन, प्रशंसा या प्रशंसा व्यक्त करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The teacher praised the students for their exceptional performance on the project.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Challenge **means to invite or stimulate someone to take action or engage in a contest. (किसी को कार्रवाई करने या किसी प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेने के लिए आमंत्रित करना या उत्तेजित करना)
 
• **Carp **means to complain or find fault constantly about trivial matters. (छोटी-छोटी बातों पर लगातार शिकायत करना या गलतियाँ निकालना)
 
• **Demur **means to raise objections or show reluctance to do something. (आपत्ति उठाना या कुछ करने में अनिच्छा प्रकट करना)
